So. Lately we have seen some gods discuss the passing around of domains, and talk about becoming more or less powerful.

I am pretty opposed to this idea, for some reasons I'll outline. I don't think it's healthy for a game like this.

Now, in character, that can be a pretty neat set of arcs, and of course I don't mean this post as an attack on any of the people engaged in this sort of activity: You guys are having fun and doing cool things.

I just don't think that there's any way that this can end well.

At its core, this game is about people coming together to build a world, and some stories in that world. People vote on what stories and creations are cool, and the general attitude is 'do whatever, it'll work.' It's been working! We've got a bunch of cool stuff made, people are collaborating to make things that neither person would think of alone, it's all nifty.

But if there's power-scaling, some gods becoming more powerful not through having more domains and more actual power than the others, perhaps by being the first to claim an extra domain here or there, then this damages this ecosystem. now some gods have more votes than others, effectively, and that is bound to cause resentment. You need to have additional arbitration, people might get peeved that they aren't getting to join in on the becoming more powerful than everyone, gods that are less likely to usurp power get pushed around even on 1v1 conflicts (which are inherently neutral)...

I think it's better to keep the game simple. Let gods be, by default, equally powerful, as they have been; Don't let gods get more or less powerful based on in-game actions. the only real metric of success in this game is 'control over the narrative,' what gets created and what those things are like, and that's better handled by an equal community and voting, and some internal politics, rather than people taking specific actions for their one god to take over more and more domains and be able to declare themselves as 'more powerful' than another god.

I think some of this also stems from there being labels of 'greater god' and 'lesser god.' Those were never intended, based on reading I did and my own admittedly possibly flawed interpretation, as a basis for which god is more powerful. They were meant to be about which god has more general focus. But whether you are a god of time or of crossroads, on a meta level neither one of you is actually 'better' or 'stronger' - you can both do most things, and have the same voting power. The domain is mostly to flavor the sorts of things you might be interested in and what sort of flavor your powers tend to have.

I think that to limit discord and keep the game pure, that gods be explicitly declared as being equal on a meta-level, and that transferring or hoarding of domains be disallowed. Non-transferable domains. Of over the course of the game someone becomes dissatisfied with their domains and wants to change them to something else they would rather play, there could be a procedure for that, but I think there shouldn't be any mechanism for gods to hoard power.

That's just my thought, and I'm just a player, I'll go with whatever people ultimately decide.
